full_judgment: 11. PW 2 Md Delwar Hossain deposed that on 21-6-1996 at about 9-30 AM the occurrence took place. On that date accused Kalam, Motaleb, Badsha, Baki, Quddus and Tajul entered into 0.22 acres of land out of 0.29 acres of Plot No. 2910 of mouse Ghorabandah with lathis in their hands. His wife Nabijan mortgaged that land to deceased Haider Ali, who was in possession of that land. At first his wife Nabijan resisted the accused persons, who catching hold of her hair gave her fist blows and then pushed her down on the ground. Thereafter when Lily Begum, the wife of the deceased, came forward the accused persons leaving Nabijan gave her (Lily Begum) blows. Thereafter, when Haider Ali went forward accused Kalam ordered to finish him. At this accused Motaleb dealt lathi blow on his back. Accused Badsha also gave lathi blow by the side of his chest (rib). He fell down raising alarm. Then accused Quddus dealt lathi blow on his chest. Accused Baki also gave lathi blow on the right side of his head. Accused Tajul drubbed in the different parts of his body. Nabijan, Badsha, Nasir (informant) and he (PW 2) witnessed the occurrence. Badsha, Lily Begum and Hannan were gained over by the accused persons. Due to assaulting the deceased died. In cross-examination he stated that the total area of plot No. 2910 was 0.29 acres. The accused had no share in this plot. He admitted that in the khatian of that land father's name of accused Quddus was recorded. Ishaq was his wife's cousin by village courtesy. He was brother-in-law of the informant. He admitted that his wife Nabijan filed Partition Suit No. 229 of 1994 at Kalahari 'Assistant Judge Court against the accused persons and others. The houses of Nut kunai, Matiar and Lokman were situated to the west of the place of occurrence land. There were also other houses in the other sides of the place of occurrence. The people of those houses were not witnesses in the case. There was a document of mortgage of the land in question. His wife Nabijan went to the place of occurrence with him. He then said that after Nabijan he went there. Lily Begum, Nasir and Badsha also went to the place of occurrence and 50/60 people came there, who were not witnesses in this case. His wife, sisters-in-law and mother-in-law were the owners in possession of the land. He admitted that due to excitement the deceased died. He denied the suggestion that the accused persons did not drub the deceased, or that he did not witness the occurrence or that no occurrence took place as he said.
